accepted.reason: Follows from dock.item (46 + 2 x 8 px padding) versus the demo's 48 + 2 x (7 + 1 border).

Aether ships a deliberately tighter dock (46 px items, 38 px tiles, 7 px inner padding) than the demo's 48/39/7. Changing it moves every dock hit target and capture crop, so it belongs with the dock parity work rather than a token tweak.
Aether paints 8 px of inner padding; the demo's 7 px plus a 1 px border gives 8 px outside. The visible inset is the same.
See dock.item: the tile is 0.82x the 46 px item (37.7, rounded to 38) instead of 0.82x the demo's 48 px (39.36).
Dock width is a consequence of the eight tiles at 46 px versus the demo's ten at 48 px (see structure.dock-items).
The compositor's text renderer has regular and bold faces only. The demo's menu buttons are 550 (medium); Aether paints regular. Add a medium face before tightening this.
The demo's resource values are 600 (medium). With regular/bold only, bold is the nearer match and keeps the values legible at 9.69 px.
The demo has ten dock tiles including Projects and App Studio. App Studio is out of scope by decision and Projects is a demo-only surface, so Aether ships eight.
Aether's window fill is 98% opaque; the demo uses color-mix(surface-solid 92%, transparent). The remaining difference belongs to the open backdrop-blur item (V8 in VISUAL-SPEC.md).
